instanceSettings.generalDesc: Configure instance-wide defaults that affect how operator-visible logs are displayed.
instanceSettings.censorUsernameDesc: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
instanceSettings.experimentalDesc: Opt into features that are still being evaluated before they become default behavior.
instanceSettings.isolatedWorkspacesDesc: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing issue runs.
instanceSettings.autoRestartDesc: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.

catchUpPolicies.skip_missed: Ignore windows that were missed while the scheduler or routine was paused.
